changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Rules_All] AS SELECT A.ID AS AssetID, A.ObjectID AS ID, A.DisplayValue AS Name, A.TypeID AS RuleTypeID, A.TypeName AS RuleType, '-1' as RuleDimensionID, '' as RuleDimensionName, 1 as Threshold, '' as Status, A.CreatedOn, A.CreatedBy, A.UpdatedOn, A.UpdatedBy FROM dbo.AssetDetail AS A where A.AssetTypeClass = 7 AND A.State = 1
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Rules_All] AS SELECT A.ID AS AssetID, A.ObjectID AS ID, A.DisplayValue AS Name, A.TypeID AS RuleTypeID, A.TypeName AS RuleType, '-1' as RuleDimensionID, '' as RuleDimensionName, R.Threshold, '' as Status, A.CreatedOn, A.CreatedBy, A.UpdatedOn, A.UpdatedBy FROM dbo.AssetDetail AS A INNER JOIN dbo.[Rule] AS R ON R.ID = A.ObjectID AND A.AssetTypeClass = 7 AND A.State = 1
